5254379a9c047b45f20a98a2e1ea61968ca97536: La Villa offers 130 km of well-marked runs – a mid-sized ski area ideal for spending 4 to 5 days without ever skiing exactly the same thing twice. The 53 lifts are generally sufficient to handle the crowds in peak season. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Northern Alps for laying the foundations of skiing with children. With a summit at 2778 m and a village at 1433 m, La Villa's snow reliability is generally good from January to the end of March. A stay in La Villa is clearly expensive: €80 for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps. Hochoetz's altitude (1410 m at the base, 2272 m at the top) helps it maintain decent snow cover in mid-winter. January and February are the most reliable months; in December and March, it is wise to check conditions before finalising a booking. The budget for a stay in Hochoetz is clearly high: 67€ for a day lift pass, plus accommodation and mountain restaurants among the most expensive in the Alps.
